blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A medical graduate from Calapan City has topped the October 2026 Physician Licensure Examination (PLE). Dr. Maxine Francesco Gwyneth Cena Baculo topped the examination with a rating of 95.50 percent, according to results released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).
